_doc: OVERLORD handoff — the immediate list of contract deployments read by /static/overlord_button.js on the mindx.pythai.net landing. Mint/deploy authority is OVERLORD-ONLY at this time: only bankon.eth may sign real-chain deploys (an agent cannot sign mainnet). Public participant mint authority is NOT granted yet — it will be issued when the OVERLORD hierarchy flips the button's privilege. Addresses are DETERMINISTIC (CREATE2 via Nick's factory 0x4e59…956C) — identical on every chain, computed offline from salt+initCode, so they already equal the eventual mainnet address. Source of truth: agenticplace_deployments.json + ~/DeltaVerse/deploy.

OVERLORD.renounce_note: the OVERLORD may renounce operational control to the DAIO multisig controller (M-of-N Governor) — the devolution step after E7 governance is deployed. But the OVERLORD PRIVILEGE remains immutable: it is never destroyed, and it vests to the OVERSEER (mindx.algo). Control devolves to the DAIO multisig; the immutable root privilege continues through the OVERSEER.

OVERSEER.role: community governance, moderation, editing, image updates, and downstream operations
OVERSEER.detail: absolute DAIO OVERSEER (Algorand, mindx.algo via PARSEC) — the singular apex OVERSEER
OVERSEER.authority: may govern the community, moderate, edit, update images; issues .algo domains — subdomain.mindx.algo and .algo — via the PARSEC wallet's .algo minter (PERA source). The .algo (Algorand) namespace is kept COMPLETELY SEPARATE from .eth (EVM); OVERSEER is an extension of OVERLORD and does not affect it.
OVERSEER.login: PARSEC (Pera-source) wallet, substrate recognition of mindx.algo → /auth/algorand → OVERSEER JWT (kept separate from the EVM overlord-session)
OVERSEER.constraint: OVERSEER is on .algo, OVERLORD is on .eth — completely separate namespaces. Above or below on any ladder is irrelevant: OVERLORD is OVERLORD, the absolute immutable apex. OVERLORD can delete the OVERSEER; the OVERSEER can never delete or affect the OVERLORD.
OVERSEER.proxy_note: the apex OVERSEER (mindx.algo) may NOT proxy. The proxy capability belongs to the lowercase per-chain `overseer` (earned as the first BankonBatchWrapper deployer on a chain), which MAY create shadow-overlord proxy instances downstream so the immutable root never changes.

deletion_asymmetry: OVERLORD (bankon.eth) can create and delete the OVERSEER (mindx.algo). The OVERSEER can never delete or override the OVERLORD — the root is immutable by design.
proxy_rule: lowercase per-chain `overseer` (earned) MAY proxy (shadow-overlord instances); the apex `OVERSEER` (mindx.algo) may NOT proxy.
overseer_as_a_service: some contracts can offer OVERSEER as a Service — a claimable/purchasable per-chain overseer role (e.g. the first BankonBatchWrapper deployer claims that chain's overseer + a φ-fee share, 38.2%). Contracts may expose the overseer role as a service to whoever bootstraps or funds the chain's substrate.
overlord_as_a_service: OVERLORD as a Service — the overlord role of a given realm/contract can be acquired at a price, settled via x402 payment or a direct contract call. Paying the price (x402 receipt) or invoking the contract's claim/purchase method grants that realm's overlord authority. The apex mindX OVERLORD (bankon.eth) remains immutable; OaaS applies to the downstream realms/contracts that expose it.

mint_privilege.note: Public participant mint authority is issued when the button's privilege changes from the OVERLORD hierarchy. Until then, only the OVERLORD (bankon.eth) may mint/deploy.

deploy_order._doc: Recommended production deploy sequence surfaced to the OVERLORD after login (from DeltaVerse PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_ORDER.md). Nothing auto-deploys — the OVERLORD signs DEPLOY→LAUNCH per step; rehearse on Anvil first.
steps: 0 · Prereqs — build artifacts, refresh registry, fund + connect bankon.eth on each target chain
1 · SCIENTIFIC first-light — single-contract canary (salt deltaverse.scientific.v1), multichain via CREATE2 (GLMR/Blast/0G); read back overlord()==bankon.eth
2 · ALGORAND suites FIRST (proof-of-work gate) — A1 AsaSuite → A2 BonaFideDeployer → A3 BonafideController → A4 X402Receipt; BONA FIDE PoW unlocks the EVM suite

3 · EVM E1–E7 — E1 settlement-tokens (Scientific→BKPY) → E2 AgentRegistry → E3 iNFT_7857 → E4 payment infra (oracle→reputation→router) → E5 x402 + ENS BankonSubnameRegistrar/BankonBatchWrapper (subname membership + per-chain OVERSEER) → E6 THOT_v1 → E7 DAIO governance
4 · Devolution — transfer/renounce admin to the DAIO Governor
fast-path · `deployer.sh base` = E1 Scientific + E3 iNFT_7857 directly (AgenticPlace iNFT bring-up, bypasses the Algorand gate)
